source_summaries.ncfrp_v51: This dataset primarily focuses on the causes and circumstances of sudden unexpected infant deaths (SUID) as reported in death certificates. It includes variables such as immediate cause of death, scene recreation details, toxicology screens, and other relevant factors that may contribute to SUID cases. However, it lacks specific variables for postconceptional age, maternal smoking status during pregnancy, preterm birth status, breastfeeding at discharge, geographic location, and various physiological measures related to experimental studies on respiratory-sympathetic coupling or neurogenesis.
